metric: semantic accuracy (%), measured in PyTorch with ncpu_computer_1d

groups.label: ID
groups.title: In distribution
groups.detail: every string up to 3, 5, 7, 10 and 13 bits on 5, 8, 11, 15 and 20-cell tapes, at the training schedule (4 free steps per cell, then ×1.5), read at the last step

groups.label: OOD +3
groups.title: 3 bits beyond the training maximum
groups.detail: 19-bit strings on a 25-cell tape, 100 + 150 steps (training schedule), mean over steps 101–250; 1,000 sampled strings

groups.label: OOD +5
groups.title: 5 bits beyond the training maximum
groups.detail: 21-bit strings on a 27-cell tape, 108 + 162 steps (training schedule), mean over steps 109–270; 1,000 sampled strings

modes.label: sync
modes.detail: every cell updates at every step (fire rate 1.0), same weights, cases and strings

modes.label: async
modes.detail: random firing with the trained probability, as in training; ID is the training validation at update 6,000
